name: Tool — Code interpreter
summary: CodeInterpreterTool inside a Prompt Agent whose orchestrator is BYOM-routed.
description: `CodeInterpreterTool` gives a Prompt Agent a sandboxed Python execution environment while the agent's orchestrator model remains `{connection}/{deployment}`. This lets users run calculations or code snippets without giving the tool its own model slot.
notes:
Verified end-to-end with `CodeInterpreterTool` on a BYOM-routed Prompt Agent. See `test.py`.

The tool has no model parameter; BYOM applies only to the host agent's orchestrator model.
